name: AlgoPattern
description: Mobile coding interview pattern practice with personal streak, XP and activity integrations.
authentication: Account endpoints require a personal access token created in the app and sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
use_cases: Check your own coding practice streak and daily progress
Display your XP and leaderboard ranks in a personal dashboard
Summarize your own practice activity by date
limitations: Account access requires user authorization and a personal access token
No public lesson content, account writes, MCP server, SDK or CLI is provided by this discovery endpoint
